title: Unit-normalized derived point-sections comparison data
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$ and finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. For a scheme $W$ use its small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], completed coefficient sheaf [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients], module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and ordinary unbounded derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Use the actual quotient-sequence rings, module categories and exact completed-scalar restriction $\rho_*$ [def-coef-ringed-sequence-site]. Use constant integral scalar restriction and tower-valued point sections [def-coef-constant-scalar-tower-sections], the lifted ring and its strict module tower evaluation and transition [def-coef-tower-trace-constructions], and completed-module tower evaluation and transition [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-tower]. Define $g^R_*$ by constant scalar restriction and point sections on completed-module towers, and $g^{\mathcal Q}_*$ by completed-scalar restriction followed by that same sections functor. Define single-level sections similarly. Write $Rg^R_*$, $Rg^{\mathcal Q}_*$ and $R\Gamma$ for their total right-derived functors, with no inverse limit. The actual sequence module category has its recorded Grothendieck abelian structure [prop-pur-kinjective-resolutions-exist]. Define $\mathrm{SectionsModel}(W)$ to consist of: (i) a functor isomorphism $Rg^{\mathcal Q}_*\cong D(\rho_*)Rg^R_*$ satisfying the canonical right-derived-unit equation on every cochain complex; (ii) for each $n$, an isomorphism $Rg^R_*\operatorname{ev}_n\cong\operatorname{ev}_nR\Gamma$ whose composite with the derived section unit and the exact evaluation factorization equals the section unit after evaluation; (iii) for every derived completed-module tower $C$ and every $m\ge n$, the square between these isomorphisms and the actual transitions commutes. These are data and defining equations, without an existence assertion.
